key_terms.عسق: Disjointed letters (Huruf al-Muqatta'at) at the start of the verse, often interpreted as referring to the Ahl al-Bayt.

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the disconnected letters 'Ayn, Sin, Qaf in Surah Ash-Shura?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, the disjointed letters 'Ayn, Sin, Qaf (عسق) are frequently interpreted as abbreviations for the four infallibles—Ali, Fatimah, Hasan, and Husayn (peace be upon them)—linking the surah's theme of divine consultation to the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt. This interpretation underscores their role as the true interpreters of the Quran and the recipients of divine guidance, reinforcing the concept of Wilayah within the context of the surah's revelation.
